paragraphs.text: Schedule 2 to the Supply Agreement. Prices are in EUR and exclude VAT.

Support item 34 with a longer description: installation on every workstation in the north and south wings, licence keys for three years, the vendor's onboarding pack, two training sessions for the site staff, and a review visit after the first month of use, all delivered by the same engineer.
The Supplier may revise these prices once a year with three months' notice.
